title: Phone: Regional Trauma Center Chaplain, 13:24

fields.orgName: Larkspur Constructors, Inc. — Stillwater Creek Interceptor Phase 2

transcript.speaker: Chaplain
transcript.text: Hello, I'm trying to reach the safety director at Larkspur Constructors. Is this the right number?

transcript.speaker: Safety Director
transcript.text: Yes, this is Priya Venkataraman, Safety Director.

transcript.speaker: Chaplain
transcript.text: This is the chaplain at the regional trauma center. I'm very sorry to have to tell you this. Your employee, Luis Marquez, was pronounced dead at 13:20. The trauma attending is here with me if you need the medical details.

transcript.speaker: Trauma Attending
transcript.text: He came in at 12:31 with crush injuries to both legs and a core temperature well below normal. When we rewarmed him and the pressure came off his legs, his heart went into an unstable rhythm. We worked on him for about eighteen minutes. We couldn't get him back. The county coroner's office has been notified, as we're required to do.

transcript.speaker: Chaplain
transcript.text: We have not reached his wife. Our records list her as his emergency contact, and your community relations lead told our front desk she's at your site. We'd ask that she not hear this by phone. Can someone from your company bring her here, or tell her in person and let us know when it's done?

transcript.speaker: Chaplain
transcript.text: Thank you. Please call me back on this number, 555-0147, once she's been told or once she's on her way. I'll meet her at the emergency entrance myself. And again, I'm so sorry for your loss, and for your crew.

voiceStyles.Chaplain: Woman in her 50s, calm, slow and gentle, a quiet hospital hallway behind her
voiceStyles.Trauma Attending: Man in his 40s, tired, plain and clinical but kind, speaking a little faster

instructorNote: This is the fatality notice. Watch whether the Safety Director logs 13:24 as the time Larkspur learned of the death, which sets the OSHA 8-hour deadline at 21:24, and makes the OSHA report now. Also watch whether the Safety Director, the pipe crew foreman and the Project Executive tell the wife together, in person and in private in trailer 4 (40 feet away), arrange her ride to the hospital, call the chaplain back, keep the name unreleased, and have the PM's call log record the call.
